findings.summary: Combined-filter list/search uses OR semantics instead of AND. GET /api/v1/capsules with q=Look and occasion=formal returned 4 capsules, 3 of which satisfy only one of the two supplied filters. Detected by reading the uncommitted capsule.service.ts change (predicates.some(Boolean)) and then confirming live. Explicitly noted that the matchesQuery doc comment and IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md both claim this exact combined case was hand-verified three times and signed off by a reviewer, and that the claim is demonstrably false.
